text:
sasha: customer report — using JSON-mode for address normalization, getting frequent parse errors (400) from our API. They reported ~120 parse failures in last hour. error snippet from our logs below.

eli: can you paste the raw model output and the request headers + prompt?

sasha: pasted. they set X-Structured-Mode: json, temperature: 0.7, max_tokens: 300. model sometimes emits trailing commas and a stray comment. example model output:

```
{"street": "123 Market St", "city": "SF",}
/* inferred confidence: 0.92 */
```

mike: yep that trailing comma will fail JSON.parse on clients. we should detect and classify this as structured_output.parse_failure.

tara: immediate ask from CS: how to mitigate for the customer? they are hitting production and need a workaround.

eli: short-term mitigation options: 1) set temperature=0 and top_p=0, 2) add stricter stop sequences (e.g., \"\n\n\" and \"\n\nEND_JSON\"), 3) post-process with a tolerant parser that strips trailing commas/comments (we can give them a snippet). recommend 1+2 for safety.

sasha: sent sample tolerant parser to customer. also they asked about telemetry — need dashboards and alerts for these parse failures.

mike: proposed observability additions:
- metric: structured_output.parse_failures.count by route/model/client_id
- metric: structured_output.parse_failure_rate = parse_failures / total_structured_requests (1m rolling)
- tag with failure_reason (trailing_comma, comment, invalid_escape, partial_json)
- histogram: latency for failed vs successful parse to catch correlation with long outputs
- trace: capture full request->model->response span for failed parses (sample 100% for failures)

eli: add events: store a redacted example (PII removed) of the failing response attached to the metric for debugging. retention short (30d) and redaction enforced before storage.

tara: note on redaction — do NOT store unredacted customer prompts. pipeline must mask emails, phone numbers before saving. also add a Sentry breadcrumb for the parse_failure with masked payload.

infra-bot: deploying fix branch: structured-mode: tolerant-preparser v0.1 to strip trailing commas/comments for 72-hour rollout to esm-prod. will route 5% of requests through tolerant path for now.

support-bot: linked ticket #CUST-4219 (customer: acme-retail). customer wants ETA and a config they can flip now.

mike: short repro steps to reproduce locally:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Structured-Mode: json" -d '{"model":"rwd-open-1","prompt":"Generate address as JSON","temperature":0.7, "max_tokens":60}'
2) check response body; if parser fails, run:

```js
// tolerant cleanup example (JS)
const clean = (s) => s.replace(/,\s*}\n/g, '}' ).replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '');
const parsed = JSON.parse(clean(modelOutput));
```

eli: alert thresholds idea: page when parse_failure_rate > 1% for >5m for any enterprise customer OR absolute parse_failures > 50 in 10m for a single client.

tara: dashboard panels: parse_failure_rate time-series, top failure reasons table, sample redacted payloads (click-to-expand), correlate with model version and temperature. add per-route breakdown.

sasha: I'll prepare a runbook for support agents with the mitigation steps, repro curl, and how to attach redacted sample to the ticket.

mike: follow-ups: (a) add structured_output.parse_failure tag to request logs; (b) add a tracing hook that sets span.tag parse_failure=true for any parse errors; (c) ensure KMS keys used for storing samples are enterprise-client-scoped.

eli: assign owners: mike -> metrics + preparser, tara -> redaction + runbook, sasha -> customer comms + CS runbook, infra -> rollout.

support-bot: noted owner labels on ticket.

sasha: urgent ask — can we get a short statement for the customer acknowledging we're throttling risky outputs and offering the tolerant parser as a temporary opt-in? I'll draft and send after infra confirms rollout. :eyes:

mike: drafting reply. infra-bot: ping once canary is live and config key to opt-in.

infra-bot: canary live at 1801242000, config key: structured_mode_tolerant=true for customer scope.

sasha: thanks team — closing triage, moving to follow-up thread for metrics/dashboard implementation. :white_check_mark:
